generations.name: Astra L (inkl. Facelift 2026)
generations.notes: Height differs by source: Opel lists 1442-1472 mm, others 1441 or 1470 mm. Width with mirrors is 2062 mm. With the 2026 facelift the PHEV got a 14 kWh (17.2 kWh gross) battery and its trunk fell to 310-1236 l, so that PHEV is its own variant. The Electric went from 54 to 58 kWh, and its trunk is still given as 352 l. ADAC measured 260 / 1080 l on a 352-l car.

generations.name: Frontera (2024, Smart Car Platform)
generations.notes: Trunk is 460 l (5 seats) and 1600 l roof-high with the 60:40 bench folded, the same for Hybrid and Electric. Width is 1795 mm without mirrors in most sources, while some list about 1850 mm. Height is 1635 mm in most sources, 1640 mm in some. A 7-seat version of the Hybrid has been announced, but no 7-seat volume was found. A forum quotes a sill height of 776 mm, which is not official, so it is not used. The Frontera replaces the Crossland.

data.notes: I kept this to 12 searches (80/20): extended queries that each pulled in dimensions and trunk volumes per powertrain. No official Opel price-list PDF could be read. The values come from Opel manufacturer figures as quoted by the ADAC catalogue, the Opel/dealer data pages, carwow, mobile.de, AUTO BILD and autozeitung. Where sources disagree, both values are in the notes. I added Crossland (sold until 2024) as a missing B-SUV. I did not add the Combo Life or Zafira Life because they are vans/MPVs from a different segment. The Insignia (ended 2022) was also left out.
